title: Local workspace overrides
description: `.reqseq/local.yaml` next to `reqseq-workspace.yaml`: settings of one person on one machine. A file Git tracks or has staged is ignored with a warning, and the places of the workspace file apply (SR-004 AK8); `workspace.init` adds `.reqseq/local.yaml` to `.gitignore` (SR-014 AK1). It overrides where a repository of the workspace lies locally. Faulty content is reported as a warning and ignored.

repositories.description: Per repository name of the workspace file: where it lies on this machine.

path.description: Absolute path, or relative to the main repository (the folder with `reqseq-workspace.yaml`). No `~` expansion.
